\begin{itemize}
\item [a.]<3->What is the probability that a person answered yes?

\begin{itemize}
\item []<5->$p(Y)=\dfrac{n(Y)}{n(S)}=\dfrac{400}{600}$
\end{itemize}
\item [b.]<6->What is the probability that a person answered yes, given
that the person is a man?

\end{itemize}

\begin{frame}{Conditional Probability}

\vspace{-.5cm}
\begin{columns}


\column{4cm}
\begin{block}<1->{Conditional Probability.}
\small
\[
p(A\mid B)=\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(B)}
\]

Probability of $A$ if \textbf{$B$ }has occurred.
\end{block}

\column{6cm}

\ex{2}{}{A heart has already been drawn. Find the probability that
a heart is drawn again (without replacement).}

\uncover<3->{$p(2^{\mbox{nd}}\mbox{\ensuremath{\heartsuit}}|1^{\mbox{st}}\mbox{\ensuremath{\heartsuit}})=$} \uncover<4->{$\dfrac{n(2^{\mbox{nd}}\heartsuit\cap1^{\mbox{st}}\heartsuit)}{n(1^{\mbox{st}}\mbox{\ensuremath{\heartsuit}})}$}

\vspace{.25cm} \hspace{0cm}\hphantom{$p(2ndh|1stH)$}\uncover<5->{ $=\dfrac{13\cdot12}{n(1^{\mbox{st}}\mbox{ \ensuremath{\heartsuit}})}$}

\vspace{.25cm} \hspace{0cm}\hphantom{$p(2ndh|1stH)$}\uncover<6->{ $=\dfrac{13\cdot12}{13\cdot51}=\dfrac{4}{17}$}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Product Rule}

\vspace{-.5cm}
\begin{columns}


\column{4cm}
\begin{block}<1->{Conditional Probability.}
\small

\[
p(A\mid B)=\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(B)}
\]

Probability of $A$ if \textbf{$B$ }has occurred.
\end{block}

\begin{block}<2->{Product Rule}
\small$p(A\cap B)=p(A\mid B)\cdot p(B)$
\end{block}

\column{6.5cm}
\begin{itemize}
\item []<2->{\rmfamily{}%
\begin{tabular}{rcl}
$p(A\mid B)$ & $=$ & $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(B)}$\tabularnewline
 &  & \tabularnewline
\uncover<3->{$p(A\mid B)$} & \uncover<3->{$=$} & \uncover<3->{$\dfrac{\nicefrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(S)}}{\nicefrac{n(B)}{n(S)}}$}\tabularnewline
 &  & \tabularnewline
\uncover<4->{$p(A\mid B)$} & \uncover<4->{$=$} & \uncover<4->{$\dfrac{p(A\cap B)}{p(B)}$}\tabularnewline
 &  & \tabularnewline
\uncover<5->{$p(A\mid B)\cdot p(B)$} & \uncover<5->{$=$} & \uncover<5->{$p(A\cap B)$}\tabularnewline
 &  & \tabularnewline
\uncover<6->{$p(A\cap B)$} & \uncover<6->{$=$} & \uncover<6->{$p(A\mid B)\cdot p(B)$}\tabularnewline
\end{tabular}}
\end{itemize}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}
